name: web text encoder stream
source: import { TextEncoderStream } from 'node:stream/web'; async function main(): Promise<void> { const stream = new TextEncoderStream(); const writer = stream.writable.getWriter(); const reader = stream.readable.getReader(); const pending = reader.read(); await writer.write('Hi'); const result = await pending; await writer.close(); console.log(result.value.length, result.value[0], result.value[1]); }
